maricopa-az.diagnosis: Named-class length exceeds the allowed-network route denominator. The listed network filter was applied as specified; excluded scenic/business, missing-network, county-name, and unsupported non-route systems were not added merely to force the ratio into band.

limitations: Network-family km can overlap when one Overture segment carries multiple eligible route networks; L_route itself counts each segment only once.
The any-undefined comparison holds v0 building/POI defined flags fixed and replaces only the transport flag; it is not a full v2 composite.
Disclosed any-undefined percentages are organizer aggregate context, not labels and not per-tract calibration targets.

method.L_named: sum of lengths for Overture classes motorway, trunk, primary, secondary, clipped with official sample tract geometry in EPSG:5070
method.L_route: deduplicated Overture road segments with at least one included routes[].network; all families clipped with official sample tract geometry in EPSG:5070
method.aggregate_cache_schema_note: The existing source-mix cache already used aggregate schema v5; route fields increment this repository to v6 (base) or v7 (with source mix), with route_schema_version=1.
method.legacy_road_length_preserved: overture_road_km remains the original v0 calculation; new named L_named is emitted as overture_named_road_km_5070
method.transport_defined_v2: L_route > 0; when zero, numeric placeholder gap=0 with defined=0
